rules: Candidate lexical spans are treated as possible code, not assumed instructions selected by the signal.
Restore intact numeric source tokens; lane3 retains כ in כוידא and value26 rather than extracting only its ו.
Compare original numeric parts and their whole-container sum. Equal sums do not mean equal machine programs.
Seed from actual generating-program output states; no arbitrary new register seed.
After executing each program, encode all eight output registers in fixed REGS order as the next program; carry the output state.
Compare forward, reversed numeric-container order, and full glyph reversal in each iteration.
Five iterations per branch are a bounded trial, not convergence, EOF, missing-data validation or semantic closure.
The output-register re-encoding rule is newly chosen for this experiment; the preceding recovered run003 append/prepend rule remains unchanged.
Hebrew output is an additive base1000 display extension, with15/16 exceptions; it is not new physical source text.
rule_note: Extend the observation window to100 total passes; transformation and feedback rules are unchanged.

source_coverage_and_boundaries.continuation_inputs: Three selected generated-container candidates from run004, with generating contexts retained. These are not an exhaustive traversal of all4100 source cells.
source_coverage_and_boundaries.initial_start: Candidate inputs and generating-program states explicitly selected in the prior experiment.
source_coverage_and_boundaries.termination_rule: No source-defined start marker, end marker, or halt opcode is specified in this feedback experiment. The100-pass limit is an investigator-set observation window.
source_coverage_and_boundaries.repeat_meaning: A repeated eight-register output, re-encoded with the same branch orientation, repeats the next program and input state under this deterministic rule. This is an execution cycle, not an observed source EOF.
